sentiment.rationale: The document reports improved year-over-year financial results (revenue up 10%, core loss per share improved from -$1.75 to -$0.47, free cash flow of $3.0B), but the forward outlook is dominated by the Alaska Airlines Flight 1282 accident and its consequences. Management explicitly withdrew 2024 guidance ('we're not issuing financial outlook for 2024 today'), announced a production rate freeze at 38 per month on the 737 until quality is assured, and stated that the 2025/2026 goals 'may take longer in that window than originally anticipated.' These are clear structural risks and a de facto guidance reduction, warranting a score of -0.50.
